statement: Let $f(x)=\frac{3x+1}{x-3}$ for $x\neq 3$. (i) Show that $f$ is its own inverse, i.e. $f(f(x))=x$. (ii) Find the fixed points of $f$ (solutions of $f(x)=x$). (iii) State the equations of the asymptotes of $y=f(x)$.
solution: (i) $f(f(x))=\frac{3\frac{3x+1}{x-3}+1}{\frac{3x+1}{x-3}-3}=\frac{9x+3+x-3}{3x+1-3x+9}=\frac{10x}{10}=x$. (ii) $f(x)=x\Rightarrow \frac{3x+1}{x-3}=x\Rightarrow x^{2}-6x-1=0$, so $x=3\pm\sqrt{10}$. (iii) Vertical asymptote $x=3$; as $x\to\pm\infty$, $f(x)\to 3$, so horizontal asymptote $y=3$.
